title: The telegram, group by group
caption: All 24 typed cipher groups of CMXV.18.1777.1-6 (107 signs), each sign replaced by the sign seven places on in the 29-sign alphabet a b c ch d e f g h i j k l ll m n ñ o p q r s t u v w x y z; the two header signs GM give m s and are left out of the reading. Amber: groups where the typed n stands for t or u (the telegraph has no ñ), settled by the sense; JXTHE, where one sign of danlel is wrong (Daniel needs i, the cipher gives l); and ETXTD, where dak stays unresolved. The two groups VJLLL LYJXY are joined before cutting into signs (ll ll).
